environment.description: Same API deployed on EC2 behind ALB, but origin access is restricted via Security Group that only allows inbound HTTPS from CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing). CloudFront distribution configured with Origin Access Control (OAC) using custom header X-Origin-Verify with rotating secret validated by ALB listener rule. CloudFront behavior has a cache policy with query string and body forwarding disabled for POST methods, and a CloudFront Function at viewer-request stage that enforces signed URLs using RSA-SHA1 canned policy with 60-second TTL. The signed URL policy includes a condition on the request body hash (x-amz-content-sha256 custom header) which is validated against the POST body. Maximum body size in CloudFront Function is limited to 1KB for this behavior via content-length header check, rejecting any request with Content-Length > 1024 bytes.

config.cloudfront_function: viewer-request: validates signed URL (RSA-SHA1 canned policy, 60s TTL), enforces Content-Length <= 1024 bytes, validates x-amz-content-sha256 against body
config.origin_verify: X-Origin-Verify custom header with rotating secret, validated by ALB listener rule
config.signed_url_requirement: all requests must have valid CloudFront signed URL with body hash binding
config.body_size_enforcement: 1024 bytes max at CloudFront edge (viewer-request function)
